old_caption: The video depicts two smartphones submerged in a pot of vigorously boiling water. The phones are positioned side by side, with one appearing to be an iPhone and the other an Android device. The iPhone on the left is displaying its home screen with various app icons visible. The Android device on the right has a black screen, suggesting it might be turned off or in sleep mode. The pot is filled with water that is visibly bubbling and frothing, indicating a high temperature. The camera remains stationary throughout the sequence, focusing closely on the pot and the phones inside. There are no significant changes in the positioning or appearance of the objects during the video; the boiling water continues to bubble vigorously around the phones, which remain submerged without any noticeable movement or interaction with their surroundings.

caption: The video depicts a round cooking pan with a dark maroon interior and metallic rim, filled with a clear liquid that boils vigorously. Two smartphones lie submerged side by side in the bubbling liquid. On the left, a dark phone keeps its screen lit, showing a bright white notification box above a dock of four app icons, the leftmost a green call symbol. To its right, a white phone rests at a diagonal with its screen black and its round home button visible at the lower end. Energetic bubbles form across the pan floor, rise, and burst, while white foam and clinging clusters outline and shift along the edges of the right phone. Bright reflections drift across that dark screen as the liquid churns. Both devices stay in essentially the same arrangement, jiggling only slightly, while the pan's rim and the intermittent metal handle at the left edge move subtly within the frame, indicating small handheld camera motion.
